value.rationale: The four-cube is a canonical vertex-transitive sixteen-vertex graph and the smallest fully periodic 4x4 square-grid hard-particle example. Its seven homology generators have a previously unknown complete B4-action with an intrinsic 3+4 splitting and Fourier support on four weight-three translation characters; rank alone cannot provide that natural invariant. Complete group symmetry and vanishing full-group invariants are useful exact equivariant data for a well-studied model, without claiming family-wide extension.
